title: Kayit olma
purpose: Implements FR-E1-02: User registration with email/phone, inline validation, OTP verification before activation, lockout after 5 failed OTP attempts, and existing-account redirect.

loading.description: Skeleton form fields (name, email, phone, password x2) and a disabled Kaydol button while initialising.

ready.description: Full registration form with real-time inline validation, password strength meter, T&C checkbox, and enabled Kaydol button when all fields valid.

empty.description: Message explains registration is unavailable with a Retry button.

error.description: Inline or banner error with user-safe message (no account enumeration) and Retry action.

offline.description: Form fields are disabled. Offline banner explains that registration requires a network connection.
